title: Hinomori Shizuku — Unseasonable Snowfall〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That's it in terms of the explanations for each activity. I want you to all have fun, but also to behave yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to the tour of Kiyomizu-dera Temple, but there are so many other things to see in that area.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, there are. I'm interested in seeing what kinds of souvenir shops there are along the streets leading up to the temple. Gojo-zaka and Sannen-zaka in particular are very famous, so I'm looking forward to walking up them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same here.
Especially Sannen-zaka since I think it appeared in that school play.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about the one with the tengu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I remember that one as well.
But I didn't realize it took place in Kyoto.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was under that impression because a tengu appeared in it. Did I misunderstand?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure... It could be fun to read up on some of these things before actually going there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been there a few times before for work, but I rarely ever got to do any sightseeing. I'm looking forward to this trip so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, we should do our homework before we go. There's gotta be some good food waiting for us, including sweets!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sweets... There must be quite a few shops that have been in business for a very long time. It will be hard to pick from them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehehe. Leave that to me. I'm pretty good at finding delicious spots!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I'm taking it for granted that we'll also be spending our free time in the afternoon together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to do that...
Do you plan on rejoining your classmates in the afternoon, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was thinking about doing that, but I won't be with them for the first day so as to not waste time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, if it's alright, I'd like to spend the afternoon with the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course! This is so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we're happy to have you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's keep discussing what we're gonna see and where we wanna visit!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes!
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See you later!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Please feel free to stop by the archery club whenever you have time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we should head back to our classroom.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Shizuku, you were grinning the whole time we were talking to Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting that we'd get to go sightseeing together since we're in different classes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, it's sort of a miracle that we get to go on the school trip at all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. So, Airi, we need to have as much fun as we can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That includes making as many memories as we can with Asahina...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, let's have another contest sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This one ended in a draw...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'll win next time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, let's...!
And I promise to do my best then!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This may be another chance for me to get to know Asahina better...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She must be thinking about Asahina again. She really is an open book.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
We should think about what we're gonna get everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, souvenirs! Something for Shii, something for Minori and Haruka and something for Miku and everyone...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can think of what to get Minori and the others together. The rest can be up to each of us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm also thinking about getting Saki and Emu something.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sure they'll really appreciate that! We should try to see what kinds of souvenir shops there are around the city.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!
